'''Ginger Ale''' is a [[Cooking|cooked]] drink. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

When consumed, it grants the player +1 [[luck]] for 5m.  As a drink, its [[Buffs|buff]] stacks with any food buffs (including Speed), but replaces any other drink buffs (''i.e.,'' from [[Coffee]] or [[Green Tea]]).

==Tailoring==
Ginger Ale is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Ginger Overalls.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Ginger Overalls]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Notes==
*Ginger and ginger ale are common remedies for nausea. Though it is not specifically noted in-game, eating [[Ginger]] or drinking Ginger Ale cures the [[Buffs#Nauseated|Nauseated debuff]]. This is hinted at by {{NPC|Birdie|placement=inline|size=24}}, the pirate's wife who lives on [[Ginger Island]].
